template.name: unlock
template.value:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <Lockscreen version="1" frameRate="60" vibrate="false" screenWidth="1080" displayDeskTop="true"> <Var name="w" expression="#screen_width" persist="true" const="true" /> <Var name="h" expression="#screen_height" persist="true" const="true" />
<Var name="click" expression="le(abs(#touch_x-#touch_begin_x),50)*le(abs(#touch_y-#touch_begin_y),50)" /> <Var name="pai" expression="3.1415926535898" persist="true" const="true" />
<!-- 居中裁剪 --> <Var name="cen_h" expression="#h/2-1320" /> <!-- 底部裁剪 --> <Var name="bot_h" expression="#h-2640" />
<!-- 位移量：swipeDY 向上为正，swipeDX 向右为正 --> <Var name="swipeDX" expression="#touch_x-#touch_begin_x" /> <Var name="swipeDY" expression="#touch_begin_y-#touch_y" />
<!-- 上滑：纵向位移>200，且大于横向偏移的绝对值 --> <Var name="upSlide" expression="gt(#swipeDY,200)*gt(#swipeDY,abs(#swipeDX))" /> <!-- 下滑 --> <Var name="downSlide" expression="lt(#swipeDY,-200)*lt(#swipeDY,-1*abs(#swipeDX))" /> <!-- 左滑 --> <Var name="leftSlide" expression="lt(#swipeDX,-200)*lt(#swipeDX,-1*abs(#swipeDY))" /> <!-- 右滑 --> <Var name="rightSlide" expression="gt(#swipeDX,200)*gt(#swipeDX,abs(#swipeDY))" />
<Var expression="1" name="notification" />
<!-- OPPO乐滑 【其他平台需注释掉本段】 --> <SupportPictorialButton w="1080" h="#screen_height"> <Triggers> <Trigger action="up"> <IntentCommand action="com.heytap.pictorial.action.START_PICTURE_MODE" category="android.intent.category.DEFAULT" package="com.heytap.pictorial" class="com.heytap.pictorial.ui.slide.PictorialSlideActivity" condition="gt(#touch_begin_x-#touch_x,250)" /> </Trigger> </Triggers> </SupportPictorialButton>
<!-- 线性变换动画 --> <Var name="loop"> <VariableAnimation> <AniFrame value="5000" time="0" /> <AniFrame value="9999999" time="9999999" /> </VariableAnimation> </Var>
<!-- 开屏动画 --> <Var name="kpdt"> <VariableAnimation> <AniFrame value="1" time="0" varSpeedFlag="QuartFun_Out" /> <AniFrame value="0" time="1200" /> <AniFrame value="0" time="99999999" /> </VariableAnimation> </Var>
<!-- 开屏透明度动画 --> <Var name="kpal"> <VariableAnimation> <AniFrame value="0" time="0" /> <AniFrame value="255" time="1200" /> <AniFrame value="255" time="99999999" /> </VariableAnimation> </Var>
<!-- 开屏命令 --> <ExternalCommands> <Trigger action="resume"> <Command target="loop.animation" value="stop"/> <Command target="loop.animation" value="play"/>
<Command target="kpdt.animation" value="stop"/> <Command target="kpdt.animation" value="play"/> <Command target="kpal.animation" value="stop"/> <Command target="kpal.animation" value="play"/>
<VariableCommand name="xq1" expression="#day_of_week-1" /> <VariableCommand name="xq" expression="#day_of_week" /> <VariableCommand name="rq" expression="#date" /> <VariableCommand name="yue" expression="#month" /> <VariableCommand name="nian" expression="#year" />
</Trigger> <Trigger action="pause">
</Trigger>
</ExternalCommands>
<!-- 全局btn --> <Button w="#w" h="#h"> <Triggers> <Trigger action="down"> <VariableCommand name="slider_flag" expression="0" /> <!-- <VariableCommand name="move_xq_start2" expression="1" /> --> </Trigger> <Trigger action="up"> <VariableCommand name="time_cdjm" expression="#loop" condition="#cdjm" /> <!-- 解锁 --> <ExternCommand command="unlock" condition="#upSlide" />
<!-- 切换版式 -->
<VariableCommand name="slider_flag" expression="ifelse(#touch_x-#touch_begin_x-150,1,#touch_begin_x-#touch_x-200,2,0)" /> </Trigger> </Triggers> </Button>
<!-- 视图层 --> <!-- OPPO 【其他平台需注释掉本行】 --> <Wallpaper src="wallpaper.jpg" /> <!-- 华为 --> <Image scaleType="center_crop" isBackground="true" src="bj.png" />
<Image src="top.png" /> $END$ </Lockscreen>
template.description: 完整锁屏模板：滑动方向判断 + 开屏动画 + 解锁命令（唤醒词 unlock / xml / theme）
